rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=30, batch_size=2, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=72, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-11: KNOB=batch_size 1->2 (single change; CEILING-CONFIRMATION probe on a NOT-yet-tried axis -- the MODEL config is otherwise FROZEN at iter-8/9: KEEP pretrain_epochs=72, itnet_k=1, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=1e-3, train_n=200, val_n=30, unet_c=24, seed=42; grad_clip REVERTED 2.0->1.0 to the proven baseline so batch_size is the SOLE change vs the frozen iter-8/9 config). PRIOR RESULTS: iter-9 (val_n 8->30 clean read)=0.9630 and iter-10 (grad_clip 1.0->2.0)=0.9565 BOTH confirm the ~0.965 CONFIG CEILING -- grad_clip 2.0 was marginally WORSE, so the last optimisation-dynamics axis (gradient clipping) is now CLOSED: the ceiling is NOT a clipping artefact. The epochs lever is saturated at k=1 (iter-6 ep40=0.9648, iter-7 ep56=0.9608, iter-8 ep72=0.9646, iter-9 ep72/val30=0.9630, iter-10 grad_clip2/val30=0.9565, all <=0.9648). The campaign record already rules OUT every MODEL capacity/data/init knob (unet_c=32 / train_n=300 / seed / lr-0.6x ALL worse on the prior run). FAILURE MODE / what's untried: batch_size has been PINNED at 1 for all 10 fresh-run iters and is the FIRST of the required-axes list (batch_size, val_chunk, small train_n bump) never probed in this run. At bs=1 every gradient step sees one noisy 2304-view sample; bs=2 averages two per-sample-ps gradients, a different optimisation-noise regime that could (a) smooth the residual-denoiser updates toward a marginally cleaner fit or (b) leave the ceiling untouched -- either way it documents the bs axis. DEFINITIVE TEST: raise batch_size 1->2 on the frozen ep72/k=1/val30 config (grad_clip back at the proven 1.0) for a clean low-variance read. HYPOTHESIS (ceiling-documentation): itnet_v2 is at its ~0.965 config ceiling; the bs=2 read lands ~0.965 +/- noise and documents that the ceiling is NOT a batch-size/optimisation-noise artefact, closing the batch_size axis toward iter-20 (next untried axes: val_chunk, small train_n bump). A lift toward ~0.971 would instead reopen optimisation-dynamics. WALL GUARD: bs=2 HALVES the per-epoch step count vs bs=1, so it is CHEAPER than iter-9/10 (which ran ~260-270s at val_n=30) -- well under the 15-min cap; val_n=30 kept for the clean read.
